description: Client-side rate limiting utilities with toast feedback, applied to social interactions (follow, like, DM, post, auth)
steps: Create src/lib/rateLimit.ts - exports: createRateLimiter(key: string, maxActions: number, windowMs: number) that returns { check(): { allowed: boolean; retryAfterMs: number } }. Uses an in-memory map of timestamps per key. Also export preset limiters: followLimiter (30/60000), likeLimiter (60/60000), dmLimiter (20/60000), postLimiter (5/60000), authLimiter (5/60000). Export a helper: checkRateLimit(limiter, actionName?: string): boolean that shows a toast 'Slow down! Try again in X seconds' when blocked and returns false.
Update src/components/social/PostCard.tsx - wrap toggleLike with rate limit check using likeLimiter before proceeding
Update src/pages/Discover.tsx - wrap toggleFollow with rate limit check using followLimiter
Update src/pages/Auth.tsx - wrap handleAuth with rate limit check using authLimiter to prevent brute force
Update src/pages/Compose.tsx - wrap the submit/insertPost function with rate limit check using postLimiter
acceptance_criteria: createRateLimiter correctly tracks action timestamps and enforces limits
checkRateLimit shows toast with countdown when rate limited
verification: Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run build
Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run test
findings: Implementation straightforward. Rate limiting uses in-memory Map of timestamps with sliding window. All 33 existing tests pass. Build produces rateLimit chunk at 0.57KB gzipped.
